title: CRA assessment record
description: One row of the ADA ECU's R14 assessment database (HLD decision D4): the append-and-upsert record a Collision Risk Assessment plugin reads and writes, keyed conceptually by trackId + warningType - which track, assessed by which plugin. Node-local schema, deliberately outside contracts/ and the sync manifest (D1): it crosses no node boundary. Every write is also appended to the [EVT] stream so the table is reconstructible offline.

trackId.description: key part 1: the assessed track's id in the ego store

warningType.description: key part 2: the assessing plugin's registry key (frozen R4 warningType, e.g. nlos_obstruction)

riskState.description: the last committed risk level (frozen R4 vocabulary)

riskStateEnteredMs.description: when the current riskState was entered, ms - the edge-trigger and dwell input

firstSeenMs.description: when this assessment record was created, ms - start of the assessment's lifetime

lastUpdatedMs.description: when this record was last written, ms - end of the assessment's lifetime so far

distanceM.description: the last composed range d_AC, m - the closing-rate input

previousDistanceM.description: the prior composed range d_AC, m - the closing-rate input

closingRateMps.description: derived closing rate, m/s; negative when the track is opening

ttcS.description: derived time to collision, s; null when the track is not closing

lastSnapshot.description: the R3 snapshot of the track, carried past its erasure so a cleared warning still has an object

lastKnownB.description: the last own-sensor B position, ego frame, so a clear can still fill the required geometry.vehicleB; null while no own-sensor B has been seen

emittedCount.description: evidence: how many R4 events this track produced

rationale.description: evidence: why the last level was chosen, mirrored to the [EVT] stream
